useTimeOutMessage

useTimeOutMessage allow us to display message that disappear after a period of time.

Example
import useTimeOutMessage from '@/utils/hooks/useTimeOutMessage'

const Component = () => {

    const [ message, setMessage ] = useTimeOutMessage(5000)

	return (...)
}

Params
PARAM	DESCRIPTION	TYPE	DEFAULT
interval	Time of message display	number	3000
Return
RETURN	DESCRIPTION	TYPE	DEFAULT
message	Message string	string	-
setMessage	Message setter	string	-
